name: firstflip-developers
description: FirstFlip API reference, guides and Postman collection. openapi.yaml is the source of truth.

scripts.build: npm run lint && npm run build:postman && npm run build:reference && npm run build:assistant && npm run build:agents && npm run build:discovery
scripts.check: npm run check:content && npm run test:export
scripts.check:guide: node scripts/check-guide-errors.js && node scripts/check-guide-scopes.js && node scripts/check-guide-events.js && node scripts/check-guide-paths.js && node scripts/check-postman-coverage.js && node scripts/check-guide-hints.js && node scripts/check-guide-diagrams.js && node scripts/check-public-links.js && node scripts/check-public-privacy.js
scripts.check:content: npm run check:guide && npm run test:sdk && npm run test:agents && npm run test:discovery && npm run build && git diff --exit-code -- postman reference assistant agents skills llms.txt llms-full.txt .well-known public-files.json
